description: Defines the MockLight class, a mock representation of a Zigbee light device with control methods and cluster management.

classes.name: MockLight
classes.description: A mock class simulating a Zigbee light device with control over power state, brightness, and power consumption.

methods.name: MockLight
methods.description: Constructor initializing the mock light with optional metering usage.

methods.name: isOn
methods.description: Returns whether the light is currently on.

methods.name: turnOn
methods.description: Turns the light on and logs the action.

methods.name: turnOff
methods.description: Turns the light off and logs the action.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the light's power state and logs the change.

methods.name: setLightLevel
methods.description: Sets the light's brightness level as a percentage.

methods.name: getOnLevel
methods.description: Returns the current on level of the light.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the current brightness level as a percentage.

methods.name: setWatts
methods.description: Sets the power consumption in watts, using metering or electrical measurement cluster.

methods.name: getWatts
methods.description: Retrieves the current power consumption in watts.
